In a nutshell 

Picnic is building a new generation of intelligent shopping experiences and fulfillment automation with AI. In our app, we help customers search in their own words, plan meals around their household and shop effortlessly. In our supply chain, automation helps us deliver efficiently and sustainably. 

As an AI Platform Engineer, you’ll build the tools and infrastructure to take AI from experiment to dependable production system: model access, tracing, evaluation, fine-tuning and low-latency serving. You'll set the technical direction for how engineers build with AI, working closely with product teams across search, personalisation, and fulfillment automation.

Tricks of the trade

Provide an environment in which agents run at optimal cost: Evolve our AI Gateway with provider integrations, model routing, fallbacks, rate limits, privacy controls, and cost attribution.

Standardise LLM tracing, evals and benchmarking: Build end-to-end tracing, evaluation, and production monitoring across prompts, models, retrieval, tools, and agent state. Help teams turn human judgement and customer outcomes into repeatable evaluation sets.

Productionize open-weight models: Create the path to fine-tune, evaluate and serve open-weight models. Support real-time inference and high-throughput batch workloads, and make latency, performance and cost trade-offs visible.

Build a paved path for getting agents to run in production: Enable developers by providing clear APIs, SDKs, templates and local tooling for structured generation, tool use, model experiments and agent workflows. Make the supported path easier than assembling one-off infrastructure.

Our Tech: You’ll work with Python on a daily basis, using frameworks like FastAPI, LiteLLM, OpenAI, Gemini and more. Supporting this core stack are Snowflake, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Helm, Terraform, Vault, and Datadog. Our open-weight training and serving stack is one of the choices you'll help us make.

We’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI or a related field
  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python
  • Proven track record building self-service AI platforms and scaling their adoption
  • Experience bringing language models or other ML/AI systems into production with meaningful reliability, latency, security, and cost requirements
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability
  • Able to take end-to-end ownership, make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions and work effectively across platform, ML/AI and product teams

+ Bonus points!

job.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.

job.description: About the Role   Imagine pioneering the mathematical and logical foundations that enable AI to fly safely in real-world, safety-critical aviation. As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT/FAA/TC-21/48), and putting real-world systems to the test.  At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision—developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most.   What You'll Do   • AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it—or pioneer entirely new strategies—to certify different supervised ML.  • EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines.  • Theoretical Foundation & Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions.  • Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics.  • Literature & Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI.  • Regulatory & Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks.  • Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks.   Requirements    What You'll Need    Machine Learning Theory & Mathematics   • ML Theory & Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the math

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Global PMO, Data will support the Global Programme Director, Data in mobilising, governing and controlling WPP’s global Data transformation programme. The role will provide the structure, quality and discipline needed to keep delivery clear, connected and moving at pace across workstreams, markets, technology teams and delivery partners.

Working closely with the Programme Director, workstream leads, PMOs and stakeholders across Enterprise Technology, the postholder will own the day-to-day programme management office rhythm: plans, RAID, governance, reporting, dependency management, actions, stage gates and delivery assurance. They will help create one version of the truth for the programme, enabling senior leaders to make informed decisions and ensuring the programme remains aligned to strategic outcomes, benefits and delivery standards.

This role is critical to strengthening programme control across the Data agenda, which is focused on modernising WPP’s data infrastructure, improving integration and standardisation, strengthening data governance, and enabling trusted analytics and AI capabilities across the group.

 

What you'll be doing:

job.description: About Allica Bank   Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.  Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.   Department Description   Payments is where our customers feel Allica every single day. We’ve built an award-winning business current account for established SMEs that pairs genuinely great technology with bestin-class customer experience – and goes beyond payments to make running a business’s finances simple and painless.   You’ll be part of the Payments Tribe, supporting the squads that together cover the full product. Product, engineering, design and data work side by side, in close partnership with Distribution, Operations, Compliance and Risk. Our job is to take the complex problems SMEs face, the ones the big banks have neglected for years, and solve them with simple, elegant products. If you want to see your work ship quickly and make a real difference to UK SMEs, this is the place to do it.      Role Description     As Product Analyst, you’ll help shape and deliver our Business Rewards Account and its card and payment features, working alongside the Senior Product Owner and the wider Tribe.     You’ll turn data, customer feedback and business requirements into clear insight and well-defined user stories, so the squads build the right things – and builds them well.    Success looks like decisions backed by evidence, a sharp and well-prioritised backlog, and processes that are simpler and more automated than when you found them.      It’s a great opportunity to learn product ownership inside a high-growth bank, with real scope to grow your product career.        Principal Accountabilities     Support the Senior Product Owner in defining and delivering features for our business current account, from discovery through to release     Gather, analyse and document requirements from Distribution, Operations, Compliance and Risk, turning them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria      Help maintain and prioritise the squad and wider Tribe backlogs, keeping them aligned to the roadmap and product and business OKRs     Track and report on product performance – such as balances, usage and customer behaviour – and surface insights that inform decisions      Gather and analyse customer feedback, then propose and lead product improvements    Work day-to-day with engineers and designers to clarify requirements, answer questions and test what’s delivered     Manage relationships with key vendors to keep delivery focused and on track    Map and improve processes, spotting opportunities to simplify and automate     Keep product documentation, tracking and risk logs accurate and up to date, flagging issues early 

job.description:
About CreativeX

CreativeX is B2B SaaS technology platform that helps global marketing teams make smarter creative decisions and elevate creative expression through the clarity of data. Our technology powers creative decision-making at some of the biggest brands in the world, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, and more.

We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance.

That's because multiple studies have shown that the "Creative" itself is responsible for half of sales lift online, higher than reach, targeting, brand, & recency combined. But creative impact has always been the least analysed and least understood component of a complex set of marketing variables.

This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift.

Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data.

Product Design Team

As a Product Designer, you'll help shape the next generation of the CreativeX platform, taking problems from discovery through to shipped experiences across defined areas of the product. You'll be the design lead in a product trio alongside a Product Manager and an Engineering Lead, owning whether users want what we build and whether they can figure out how to use it, while sharing discovery, outcomes and trade-offs with your partners. CreativeX is a complex product with rich data, multiple user types and increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities, and as AI increases the volume and speed of creative production, you'll make that complexity work for marketers, helping them measure performance fast, find the patterns behind what's working and see whether their full set of ads is delivering the strategy. Our roadmap is framed as problems to solve, not screens to make, so we expect you to bring a point of view. Product Design is a small, hands-on team in a scale-up: you'll be trusted with real ownership early, and this hire is an important step in growing the team.

What you will do

  • Own design for defined product areas, from understanding the problem through to working with Product and Engineering to ship the right experience
  • Get close to marketers and creative teams through customer conversations, research and usability testing, using what you learn to inform design decisions
  • Partner with Product and Engineering in discovery
job.title: Product Designer

job.description: Scope   automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.  Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.  Dave is an inspector. Today he's climbing through one of Europe's biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he'll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.  We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we're building the world's largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.  It's a $2T market and we're just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.  We've assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.  Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by   Index Ventures  , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date.     About the role   We're hiring our first Product Designer.  Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. You'll work the same way, with design as your edge, and help the engineers around you to build a better product. That covers the whole experience, not just the surface: which problem we solve, how the flow works, what happens when things go wrong, and how it all looks. You'll work closely with the engineers, with Ish our Product Manager, and with Jakob the CTO.  We work in person five days a week from our office in Farringdon.     What you'll work on   Some examples of surfaces in our product that will need your help:    Our mobile app gets used inside tanks and on top of pressure vessels. People wear thick gloves, there's usually no signal, and one hand is often holding on to something. Most of what makes a normal app pleasant doesn't apply there, so a big part of the job is figuring out what does.    Then there's the report. How AI and the inspector will work together to produce 40 page reports and review them is something nobody has designed well yet.    Inspectors but also decision makers should be able to ask things like "Which tanks were over the corrosion limit last year?". Sometimes the right interface will be a chat but often it isn't.     What you'll do     Go on site with inspectors and test your designs there, gloves and all.    Own the design of every launch, down to the empty states.    Prototype fast, in code when it helps. job.description: About the Role   There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.  Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations  Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things  As Product Lead, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.  This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.     What You'll Own     Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.    Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.    Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.    Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.    Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.    Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.    Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.    Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.    Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.       What We're Looking For      Technical     Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.    Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.    Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers. Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.    Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious. As AI reshapes how people discover information online, companies need new ways to understand where they appear, how they perform, and where the next growth opportunities lie. About the role  We're looking for a second Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Peec AI shows up in the world. job.description: About the Role   There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.  Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.  Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.  As Product Owner, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.  This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.     What You'll Own     Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.    Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.    Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.    Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.    Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.    Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.    Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.    Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.    Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.       What We're Looking For      Technical     Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.    Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.    Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.    Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.       Product & AI     Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.    Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.    Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.    Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.    Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.       Mindset     Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.    Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.    Able to challenge engineers and researcher

job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Global Programme Manager, Enterprise Data will support the Enterprise Data Programme Director in leading and delivering WPP’s global Enterprise Data programme. The role will be responsible for managing the day-to-day delivery of key programme workstreams, ensuring plans, resources, risks, dependencies and outcomes are actively managed across markets, technology teams, business stakeholders and delivery partners.

This is a hands-on programme leadership role, providing delivery momentum, structure and coordination across a complex enterprise transformation. The postholder will work closely with workstream leads, PMO, Finance, technology teams and vendors to ensure delivery is controlled, decisions are progressed, risks are managed and programme outcomes remain aligned to the Data strategy.

The role will play a key part in delivering WPP’s enterprise data transformation, supporting modernised data platforms, improved integration and standardisation, stronger data governance, trusted analytics and AI-ready data foundations across the group.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Manage delivery of key Enterprise Data programme workstreams, ensuring scope, milestones, plans and outcomes are clearly defined and actively progressed.

job.description:
Role: QA Engineer

Department: QA

Location: UK - London

Reports into: Head of QA

About us:

At Disguise, we are dedicated to providing innovative, reliable, and high-performance software and hardware solutions to our customers. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking to add a talented mid-level QA Engineer to our team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about coding and quality assurance, with a deep understanding of Python, to enhance our QA processes through automation and efficiency.

About the role:

As a QA Engineer, you will play a critical role in the development and execution of automated test scripts, frameworks, and custom tools to ensure the quality and performance of our software and hardware products. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to integrate automated testing into our software development lifecycle. This is an opportunity to be a key player in both testing and development, ensuring that we deliver top-quality products to our customers.

What you will do:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts using Python to enhance our testing processes
  • Work with the QA Engineering team to identify areas for automation and build robust, reusable test suites.
  • Write test scripts to validate new features, products, and bug fixes across various platforms and environments.

job.description:
Build the next generation of autonomous construction robotics  
 At MESH, we develop autonomous robotic systems that automate end-to-end rebar construction. Bridging digital design and physical automation, our multidisciplinary team transforms advanced robotics research into robust, production-ready industrial systems deployed globally. 
 Tasks 
  Role description  
 We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to develop and productize software across the full robotics stack from perception and motion planning to control and system integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. You will take ownership of the engineering work required to turn promising research and algorithms into robust and mature capabilities that can be deployed and maintained in real-world robotic systems. 
 What You Will Work On 
 You will contribute across the full robotics software stack, including: 
 
 Perception: 2D/3D sensing, point-cloud processing, object and feature detection, pose estimation, calibration. 
 Motion Planning: collision checking, trajectory generation and optimization, kinematics, robot/world modeling, and integration of planning algorithms. 
 Robot Control: integration with industrial robot controllers, HAL layers, trajectory execution, real-time or near-real-time control interfaces, state monitoring, and coordination of multi-robotic systems. 
 System Integration: connecting robotics SW, application logic, hardware, and external systems into reliable end-to-end robotic applications. 
 Robotics Infrastructure: reusable software components, interfaces, configuration, logging, diagnostics, testing, simulation, and deployment infrastructure. 
 
 Your Responsibilities 
 
 Design, implement, test, and maintain robotics software primarily in C++ and Python. 
 Develop and integrate components across the full robotics SW stack. 
 Take algorithms and prototypes and mature them into reliable software components. 
 Build automated tests, simulation-based tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and system-level validation where appropriate. 
 Work with industrial robots, sensors, cameras, external axes, and other automation hardware. 
 Develop clean interfaces between robotics algorithms, hardware drivers, application software, and higher-level systems. 
 Diagnose complex problems that span software, algorithms, networking, robot controllers, sensors, and hardware. 
 Improve observability through structured logging, diagnostics, error reporting, and system health monitoring. 
 Support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of robotic systems. 
 
 Requirements 
  What We Are Looking For  
 Required 
 
 Masters degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field. 
 Strong software engineering skills in C++, with working knowledge of Python. 
 Experience developing software for robotic or other complex hardware systems. 
 Good understanding of several areas of robotics, such as, motion and trajectory planning, robot control, vision, sensor and robot calibration. 
 Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2 or similar 
 Comfortable working with Linux and modern software development workflows using Git, code reviews, build systems, debugging tools, and automated testing. 
 Ability to debug problems across multiple layers of a robotic system rather than treating individual components in isolation. 
 Strong understanding of software architecture, modularity, interfaces, and maintainability. 
 
 Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage: 
 
 3D perception using point clouds, depth cameras, stereo systems. 
 Libraries such as Eigen, PCL, OpenCV, or similar. 
 Collision detection, robot/world modeling, trajectory optimization, or numerical optimization. 
 Real-time or high-performance robot communication and control. 
 Profiling, performance optimization, concurrency, and multithreaded C++. 
 Deploying and supporting robotic systems outside a controlled R&D environment. 
 CI/CD and automated testing for robotics software. 
 Experience working with industrial robotic arms such as ABB 
 
 We do not expect you to be an expert in every part of the robotics stack. We are looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more robotics areas, and the ability and interest to work across subsystem boundaries. 
  Eligibility  
 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Switzerland or be eligible to obtain the required Swiss work authorization without employer-sponsored visa support. 
  Why Join MESH?  
 At MESH, you will work on robotics problems where advanced R&D meets real-world industrial deployment. Our goal is not only to develop new robotics capabilities, but to turn them into systems that solve challenging problems in real world deployments. 
 
 You will have opportunities to work across the full robotics SW stack including system integration, and the software architecture connecting them rather than being restricted to a narrow subsystem. 
 You will work directly on the engineering challenges that take robotics from promising prototypes to robust, repeatable, and deployable solutions. 
 Solve challenging real-world robotics problems. Work with industrial robots, 3D vision systems, complex environments, and applications where conventional automation approaches reach their limits. 
 See your work operate on real hardware. Develop software that moves beyond simulation and demos and becomes part of robotic systems deployed in real production environments. 
 Have impact across the system. As part of a small, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will work closely across robotics, software, and hardware, with the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and how our robotics platform evolves.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast growing team building an agent native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing how AI agents - not humans - retrieve, evaluate, and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval and ranking under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24 by 7.

  • Developing ranking and retrieval approaches for multi step, agent driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

The Opportunity  
  The infrastructure that runs the modern world (power grids, data centres, fibre networks, EV charging) is being built out faster than at any point in a generation. The companies doing that work are drowning in the volume, variety, and velocity of it. Sitetracker is how they stay ahead of it.  
   
  Sitetracker is the AI-native platform for infrastructure lifecycle management, covering project, construction, operations, and asset management in one system of record. Scout, our enterprise AI agent platform, is what sets us apart. Scout does the work, not just reports on it, and it stays grounded in the customer's own data so the answers are trustworthy enough to act on. That is what holds up in an enterprise procurement review when a bolted-on chatbot does not.  
   
  You will be our go-to Strategic Account Executive for the Middle East territory. Your job is to grow revenue and to shape how Sitetracker leads the AI-native transformation of digital infrastructure across the Middle East. You will own a priority territory with strong product-market fit, backed by proven customer outcomes, a differentiated platform, and strong demand generation.  
   
  Our top performers work as enterprise advisors. They bring strategic thinking, curiosity, and real customer empathy. They own outcomes, not quotas. If you raise the bar, love winning new logos, and want autonomy, scale, and purpose, this is a role worth a serious look.  
   
  What You'll Do  
  You will join a sales team that pairs start-up pace with enterprise ambition. This is a build role, not an inherited book of business. You will define and execute the go-to-market strategy for your territory, engage new prospects, and guide them through high-stakes decisions with precision and insight.  
   
  Every deal moves the industry forward, whether that is energising a new grid interconnection, standing up a data centre, upgrading a telecom network, or scaling EV charging. You will orchestrate complex buying journeys across large stakeholder groups, partner cross-functionally with product, marketing, and services, and earn the trust of executives on both sides. This is a quota-carrying role in a MEDDPICC environment, and it is also a chance to lead, to sell a genuinely differentiated platform, and to leave a mark.  
   
  You will be selling into a market that is actively rethinking how it uses AI. Part of the job is separating signal from hype: showing skeptical enterprise buyers what agentic AI grounded in their own operational data actually changes about how their teams work, and what it is worth.

Today that means we are driven to make a difference – net zero by 2040 – and it’s our people who ensure we succeed. With almost 500 people working across our IT Delivery and CIO functions, together we design, build and support a broad range of technologies and services to deliver on our strategic objectives – decarbonised electricity, resilient infrastructure and empowered customers. To further enhance our capabilities and to transform ESB to a data driven and digital utility, we are looking for Graduates to join our highly motivated and skilled team of IT professionals where you will have the opportunity to deliver results in a fast-paced, innovative team environment. Our IT Graduate Development Programme is structured into six distinct career paths where you will be able to grow your experience, as well as develop the necessary skills to help you on your way to career success. Infrastructure Operations As an IT Graduate within ESB's Infrastructure Operations team, you'll gain hands-on experience working with the cloud, platform, and data centre technologies that power one of Ireland's largest and most critical energy networks. Working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists, you'll help deliver secure, resilient, and high-performing IT services that support ESB's day-to-day operations and enable its Net Zero 2040 ambitions. This is an exciting opportunity to build practical expertise across cloud infrastructure, platform management, service reliability, automation, and operational excellence within a large-scale enterprise environment. You'll develop a strong foundation in modern infrastructure technologies while contributing to projects that have a real impact on how ESB delivers energy for Ireland. As part of the team, you'll support the management, maintenance, and continuous improvement of core IT infrastructure services. You'll gain exposure to proactive monitoring, infrastructure lifecycle management, security best practices, and digital transformation initiatives, while working in a collaborative and inclusive environment that encourages innovation, learning, and professional growth. Application Operations As an IT Graduate within ESB's Application Operations team, you'll play a key role in supporting the applications that enable critical business processes across the organisation. From enterprise platforms and bespoke business systems to mobile applications, you'll gain valuable experience in ensuring applications remain reliable, secure, and high-performing for thousands of users across ESB. Working closely with technology teams and business stakeholders, you'll develop an understanding of how digital services support ESB's operations while building practical skills in application support, service management, performance optimization, and continuous improvement. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to innovative technology solutions that help drive operational excellence and support ESB's Net Zero 2040 strategy. As part of the team, you'll help enhance and optimize a diverse portfolio of Enterprise, Custom-Built, and Mobile applications. You'll gain exposure to service delivery, stakeholder engagement, incident and problem management, service improvement initiatives, and future technology planning. Along the way, you'll develop the technical and professional skills needed to build a successful career in IT while helping shape the future of digital services within ESB. What to expect Our bespoke IT Graduate Development Programme includes: Structured Rotations: – Our graduate programme is typically structured into targetted rotations aligned with career paths and capability development where you will build your IT and business knowledge through challenging assignments, a diverse range of business activities, and the potential to work on projects. Learning & Development: – Central to our programme is your learning and development. Structured leadership development, training opportunities, innovation programmes. on-the-job learning and work-shadowing are complemented with personal development programmes and supports designed to help you grow professionally and personally. Performance Orientated: – At the start of each of your rotations, you will agree with your Line Manager the goals of the assignment and put in place the steps to help achieve them. Ongoing one-to-one conversations and management reviews will ensure that you are constantly working towards achieving your professional status and position you for a career with ESB. Supportive Working Environment: – In addition to your immediate support network of Line Manager, Middle Manager, Team Colleagues and Graduate Peers, you will also be assigned a Buddy and a Mentor. Social Networking: – Our Graduates are encouraged to get involved in all sorts of Sports and Social activities. Anything from Tag Rugby, Cricket, Soccer and GAA to language classes, team building challenges, charity work and graduate social events. Our clubs, societies and networks are a great way to build your contacts and of course make new connections. Why work with us? We offer a competitive graduate salary and a comprehensive benefits package built on four pillars of Reward, Career, Community, and Well-being: Progressive, hybrid working model Career development through mentoring and training Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities Sports and Social Clubs Credit Union access Pension Scheme Employee well-being programmes Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion Great team environment with our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Trusted, and Driven Location This position will be based in ESB Head Office, F27, 2 Fitzwilliam Street, Dublin 4. Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business. What We Look For? You should have (or be working towards) a minimum 2.1 Honours Degree in IT, Computer Sciences, Business Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Finance or an equivalent course where IT was a component. Proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced team environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent analytical skills, combined with the ability to learn quickly. job.description: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and open up new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a lot of work ahead. That gives you an unusual opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Startup SaaS Platforms team works with European startups in one of Stripe’s must-win segments. SaaS platforms are companies that use Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their products, such as Shopify, Mindbody, and Lightspeed. For these companies, their partnership with Stripe is vital to the success of their businesses. SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe, and our team finds and wins Stripe’s future strategic accounts in Europe. We partner with high-potential companies early and help them use Stripe’s solutions to better support their users, scale globally, and create new revenue streams by monetising payments and financial services. What you’ll do We’re hiring an Account Executive to win new business with pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platform startups across the United Kingdom and Ireland. This is a new-logo role. Your job is to find the most promising founders building platforms today, win their business for Stripe before they choose another provider, and get them live with the right integration from day one. You’ll work alongside our SaaS Platform Account Executives as the team’s dedicated hunter for the earliest stage of the market. You’ll own the pre-revenue and early-revenue segment end to end, from generating pipeline and handling inbound demand to closing deals and getting each new platform activated. Early-stage platforms make their payments decisions early and rarely revisit them. They also often need several products from the start, including embedded payments, connected-account onboarding, payouts, and monetisation. Winning them early and selling the right solution gives Stripe a lasting position with the platforms that will scale fastest. This is a high-velocity sales role with short cycles, a high volume of opportunities, and plenty of competitive deals. Responsibilities Build and run your own pipeline. Prospect high-potential pre-revenue and early-stage SaaS platforms across the United Kingdom and Ireland, and turn inbound interest from early-stage platforms into qualified opportunities. Win new logos. Run fast, consultative sales cycles from discovery to close and win competitive evaluations against other payments providers. Sell the right solution from the start. Understand each founder’s business model and position the right Stripe Connect integration and payments monetisation strategy so that new platforms are set up to scale. Close and activate. Negotiate and close deals, then work with Solutions Architects, Product, Risk, and Operations to get new platforms live quickly. You’ll be measured on new business won and activated. Source new business through the ecosystem. Build relationships with founders, venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup communities across the United Kingdom and Ireland to create pipeline and grow Stripe’s presence among early-stage founders. Work with the SaaS Platform Account Executive team. Share market intelligence on emerging platforms and pass on accounts that have moved beyond the early stage so that each seller can focus on the opportunities where they can have the greatest impact. Bring what you learn from the market back to Product and go-to-market teams to sharpen how Stripe wins early-stage platforms. Who you are You’re a self-starting hunter who enjoys finding and winning new business. You like working with founders, you’re comfortable leading technical conversations, and you can run many deals at once without compromising quality. You know how to qualify quickly, create urgency, and close. You’re competitive, resilient, and keen to build your skills in a fast-changing environment. We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 2+ years of experience in a new-business sales role, such as a closing Account Executive role or a Sales or Business Development Representative role, with a track record of progression and pipeline generation A proven record of meeting or exceeding new-business targets Strong prospecting skills, with experience building your own pipeline through outbound and inbound channels Experience running high-velocity sales cycles from the first conversation through to close The ability to understand technical products and explain their value clearly to technical and non-technical buyers Comfort with rejection, competitive deals, and ambiguous, fast-moving environments A bias towards team success, collaboration, and knowledge sharing Proficiency in written and spoken English Preferred qualifications Experience selling to early-stage or venture-backed startups, ideally in the United Kingdom and Ireland An established network in the United Kingdom and Ireland startup ecosystem, including founders, venture capital firms, and accelerators Experience selling at a high-growth technology company Comfort with API-first products and technical sales conversations Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS platform sales

job.description: Overview Susquehanna is looking for highly motivated full-time students for our 10-week quantitative strategy development summer internship program based at our EU Headquarters in Dublin, Ireland. This is a computationally intensive role that will allow you to use your strong technical skills to solve problems at the intersection of trading, quant and technology. Throughout the summer, you will receive education about how markets work by going through a deep dive into financial markets and Susquehanna's approach to trading. You will also work on challenging projects for our trading strategy development teams in spaces such as signal creation and detection, quantitative strategy analysis, and low latency C++ strategy development. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to work on projects side by side with senior developers who understand the nuances of building complex tr ading strategies. Our quantitative strategy developers are part of our high-performing team s that build some of the most powerful trading systems in the finance industry. This is a computationally intensive role that will allow you to utilize both your data analysis and technology skills. What we're looking for Class of 202 8 : You are a master’s or bachelor’s student in their penultimate year of study, majoring in a quantitative and/or STEM discipline such as computer science, computer engineering, mathematics or data science for example. You intend to graduate and begin full time employment by August 2028. Clear Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others . Ambitious: You’re someone that enjoys setting personal goals and giving your all to achieve them. Be it in Arts, Sports, Academics, or another passion; you’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential. Technically Proficient: Strong software development skills in (Python and a compiled language). Experience and comfort working with data using libraries such as Pandas, Polars, or NumPy. You will have exceptional quantitative, logical reasoning, and analytical skills. Problem Solver: When it comes to solving problems, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions. What's in it for you: Education: We are renowned for our market-leading education and training programmes . You will attend classes covering a vast range of topics (Options Pricing, Machine Learning, Data Analysis Techniques, Game Theory, Trader Talks, In-house trading games… the list goes on!) from some of the most experienced employees in Susquehanna . Collaboration : You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Culture : O ur non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive, and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna. Perks : We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our interns . Located in Ireland's Financial Services Centre, in the heart of Dublin's city centre , our office features free onsite catering, a games room, and a fully equipped in-house gym. Throughout the summer, interns enjoy weekly social events. For those joining us from outside Dublin, we also provide accommodation for the duration of the internship. About Susquehanna Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. Additional details ** We hire for our QSD internship on a rolling basis. There are limited places on our 2027 QSD internship, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early.* * The interview process for this role will be a series of interviews including coding, mathematics, system design and behavioural interviews. Our summer internship is 10 weeks and runs from late June to late August. Applicants for our summer internship must legally eligible to work in Ireland. Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us. If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com . Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.

job.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

The People Technology Integration Engineer, Workday is responsible for designing, building, and evolving integration and data solutions across SIE’s global Workday platform and broader HR technology ecosystem.

This role operates as an independent contributor within People Technology Services, owning the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and reliable system integrations. The role focuses on enabling seamless data movement, system connectivity, and interoperability across platforms, ensuring that integrations are maintainable, performant, and aligned with architectural standards.

A key focus of this role is the design, delivery, and ongoing support of payroll integrations, ensuring accurate, secure, and timely movement of employee and payroll data between Workday, global payroll providers, and downstream systems.

Working within an Agile product delivery model, this role contributes to both the continuous evolution of integration capabilities and the stability of core data flows. The Integration Engineer partners closely with Platform Engineers, Product Managers, and Data teams to deliver cohesive, end-to-end technology solutions.

This role is suited for individuals with strong technical depth who are motivated to build and improve integration architecture and data pipelines within an enterprise environment.

What you'll be doing:

Integration Engineering & Solution Design

  • Design, build, and implement scalable integration solutions across the Workday platform and connected systems, including:
  • Workday Studio
  • Core Connectors and EIBs
  • API-based integrations (REST/SOAP)
  • Define and apply integration design patterns that promote scalability, reusability, and maintainability
  • Design secure and reliable data flows, including transformation logic, orchestration, and error handling
  • Evaluate integration approaches and make informed design decisions, balancing business needs, system constraints, and long-term sustainability
  • Own end-to-end delivery of integration solutions, including design, build, testing, and deployment readiness
  • Design, build, and maintain payroll integrations between Workday and external payroll providers, financial institutions, and related downstream systems.
  • Partner with Payroll, HR, and external vendors to translate payroll requirements into secure and reliable integration solutions, including reconciliation, error handling, and issue resolution across time-sensitive payroll cycles.

Integration Architecture & Platform Connectivity

  • Contribute to the design and evolution of integration architecture across the People Technology ecosystem
  • Ensure consistent patterns for system connectivity, data exchange, and interface design
  • Document integration designs, data flows, and technical architecture to support maintainability and governance
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enable seamless end-to-end system interactions

Data Engineering & Reporting Solutions

  • Design and deliver data extracts, reporting solutions, and document generation capabilities (e.g., BIRT, Docs for Layouts) as part of the broader People data ecosystem
  • Develop and maintain calculated fields and data structures to support integration and reporting use cases
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across integrations and downstream systems

Platform Reliability & Operations

  • Maintain reliability of integration pipelines through proactive monitoring, issue diagnosis, and resolution
  • Identify root causes of failures and implement structural improvements to enhance stability and performance
  • Optimize integrations for performance, scalability, and fault tolerance
  • Partner with stakeholders to prioritize enhancements and manage competing demands

Delivery & Agile Execution

  • Translate business and technical requirements into well-defined integration solutions
  • Participate actively in Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives
  • Own and deliver assigned workstreams within sprint cycles
  • Execute and support testing activities (unit, integration, UAT), ensuring end-to-end data validation
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineers and functional partners to deliver integrated, cross-domain solutions

Governance, Security & Quality

  • Ensure all integration solutions meet data privacy, security, and audit requirements
  • Implement secure data exchange practices, including encryption, authentication, and secure file transfer (e.g., SFTP)

Job Description

AI is the biggest shift in how organisations build anend work in a generation. The organisations who win will be the ones who can move beyond a working demo and get genuinely production-grade, multi-agent AI systems live, reliable and maintained at scale. That is the hardest part of the journey, and it's where this role sits.

As an Applied AI Consultant, you bring that change to the top table. You've done this before — as a CTO, a founder, or the most senior engineering leader in your organisation — and you've taken a whole organisation through the shift to becoming AI native, not just a team. You are as comfortable setting direction with a Chief Executive or Chief Technology Officer as you are going deep on architecture with a lead engineer, and our largest, most strategic customers will look to you to set the pace of their AI transformation.

You'll shape and lead our most significant engagements, secure and hold executive sponsorship, and set the standard the rest of the team builds towards.

What You'll Do

  • Own our most strategic engagements. Lead full-scale AI transformation programmes for our largest and most complex customers, from initial vision through to organisation-wide adoption.
  • Set direction with the C-suite. Work directly with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs and other executive stakeholders to shape AI strategy, secure sponsorship, and connect adoption to the outcomes the business actually cares about.
  • Transform whole organisations. Draw on your own experience taking an organisation through AI-native transformation to guide customers through the same shift — at the scale of a function, a division, or the whole business.
  • Bring the vision. Act as a genuine AI visionary for our customers — someone who can see past the immediate ask to where the technology and the business are both heading, and bring customers with you.
  • Shape how we sell and deliver. Help shape full transformation deals, define how value gets measured, and protect the trust our partners and customers place in Version 1.
  • Lead and mentor. Set the standard for Applied AI Consultants, mentor senior hires, and help build the playbooks and IP that make the whole programme better.
  • Represent Version 1 externally. Build our reputation and thought leadership in the market, as a visible, credible voice on AI adoption and transformation.

Qualifications

What good looks like

  • A proven AI transformation leader at organisation scale. You've personally led an organisation — not just a team — through becoming AI native, as a CTO, founder, or the most senior engineering leader in the room.
  • Genuine AI vision. You don't just keep up with the field, you have a real point of view on where it's heading and what it means for how businesses operate — and people want to hear it.
  • Fluent at C-suite level. You've operated as a peer to CEOs, CTOs and other executives, and you're just as comfortable setting strategy in the boardroom as you are getting hands-on with architecture.
  • Deep technical credibility. Your AI engineering depth is real and current, not historical — engineers and architects trust your judgement because you've stayed close to the work.
  • A track record customers can check. You can point to organisations you've genuinely transformed, and to the outcomes that resulted, not just initiatives you were involved in.
  • Comfortable owning the outcome. You take full ownership of the largest, most ambiguous, highest-stakes engagements, and you bring the judgement and composure the moment needs.

What We're Looking For

  • 10–15+ years in senior engineering leadership, as a CTO, founder, or the most senior technical leader in your organisation.
  • Direct, personal experience leading an organisation-wide shift to becoming AI native, with outcomes you can speak to in detail.
  • A genuine track record operating at C-suite level, comfortable setting direction alongside CEOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders.
  • Deep, current AI engineering expertise: production LLM and agent experience, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale.
  • Experience shaping or building AI solutions and intelligent applications, not just overseeing them.
  • Strong programming fundamentals and enough hands-on depth to be credible with architects and senior engineers.
  • A degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience as a founder or CTO of a business that itself went through AI-native transformation.
  • A public profile — thought leadership, speaking, writing, or advisory work — in applied AI or AI transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with the Claude API, Claude Code, MCP, or GitHub's AI tooling.
  • Domain depth in a regulated or enterprise vertical: public sector, financial services, or healthcare and life sciences.
  • Experience shaping large-scale commercial deals or outcome-based propositions.

Additional Information

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
  • Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
  • Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
  • Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
  • Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
  • Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
  • Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
  • Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

Global Operations, Operations Summer Analyst

Dublin, UK

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities, and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognising, and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

The team:

Global Operations (GO) teams manage the critical systems and multiple platforms needed to maintain the enterprise's market-leading positions in key segments. By performing vital functions throughout the end-to-end lifecycle of products, services, and client transactions, we help deliver seamless client outcomes while maintaining a strong risk and control environment.

These activities include client onboarding, trade validation, settlement, servicing, reporting, reconciliations, risk management, process improvement and change delivery.

Programme Overview

Our Summer Analyst Programme in Dublin is designed to provide you with a unique experience within Global Operations. Opportunities are available in the following teams, with alignment based on your interests, development opportunities, and current business needs:

Global Markets Operations (GMO) – Provides end-to-end operational support for Global Markets sales, trading and underwriting activities across securities, loans, and derivative products. Our teams manage critical activities throughout the trade lifecycle, including trade processing, settlement, reconciliation, collateral management, and client servicing, helping deliver seamless market execution.

Training and Development

Your training and development is our top priority with extensive formal training offered at the start of the programme in addition to on‑the‑job training, virtual spotlight sessions, Executive Speaker Series, networking events, and hands‑on project work, with mentorship throughout.

Responsibilities:

As a Summer Analyst, you will be aligned to one team based on your interests and current business needs. Your key tasks and responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  • Develop an understanding of client, account, and product reference data management processes.
  • Support settlement, clearing, and reconciliation activities across a range of products and services.
  • Build knowledge of trade lifecycle processes, including trade validation, maintenance, exception management, and reconciliation.
  • Build knowledge of the products, services and operational processes that support the bank and its clients
  • Analyse data, identify trends and contribute to business insights, process reviews, and operational excellence initiatives
  • Develop an understanding of risk management, controls, governance and regulatory requirements
  • Support project delivery, business analysis and stakeholder engagement activities
  • Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations and updates for business partners and senior stakeholders


Eligibility

  • Candidates are required to be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited college or university with a completion time frame between September 2027 and July 2028. Completion means that you have completed all final exams, coursework, and have no outstanding requirements for graduation. Please note that we reserve the right to request evidence of this completion date before extending an offer.
  • On track for a minimum 2:2 degree classification (or equivalent)
  • Must be available to join the programme from June 2027 to August 2027


Candidates who perform well during the internship may be offered full time employment to commence in July 2028; some lines of business may also offer the opportunity of a January or April start date. You must be available to join on one of these start dates if offered, unfortunately we are unable to offer deferrals

What We Are Looking For

Essential:

  • Clear motivation for exploring an Operations career within financial services
  • Evidence of self-learning outside of studies, and efforts to advance technical skills
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to solve problems and positively challenge existing processes
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, and ability to interact with a variety of people
  • Display evidence of strong teamwork, leadership, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities
  • Demonstrate integrity and ethics by earning other’s trust and respect through consistent honesty and professionalism in all interactions
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is a pre-requisite


Most importantly, we are looking for individuals with a growth mindset who are keen to learn, embrace challenges and contribute fresh perspectives while delivering an exceptional experience for our clients and teammates.

Our recruitment process

Analyst internship and full-time recruiting takes place on a rolling basis once our applications are open. Assessments often begin before the deadline, so it is best to submit your application early as this will give you the best chance of being considered for the role.

We care deeply about shaping the world of work to be an equal and inclusive one – and that starts with our recruitment process. We know just how important and valuable it is to have a wide range of skills, backgrounds and experiences shaping our work and ideas. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, and we are proud to focus on attracting, retaining, and developing diverse talent within Bank of America. Together, we aim to mirror the customers, clients, and communities we serve.

We are an equal opportunities employer, and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity or gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins, age, sexual orientation, being pregnant or on maternity leave, socio-economic background, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. The Bank selects candidates for interview based on their skills, qualifications, and experience.

What if I need workplace adjustments?

We are committed to ensuring our online application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. If you need a workplace adjustment to search for a job opening, need help completing your application or video interview, please email juniortalentemea@bofa.com and let us know. We will be more than happy to discuss the support you need, and we will respond to your email within two business days.
