job.description:
Job Description

A wonderful opportunity has arisen for a Digital and Data Quality (Snr Specialist) to join the global Digital & Data Quality (DDQ) team in Ballydine, reporting to the Associate Director of DDQ for EMEA.

In this hands-on role, you will support manufacturing, laboratory, and logistics teams to assess, select, and validate computerized systems used in GMP processes, ensuring validation effort matches system complexity and risk. You will provide quality oversight for computerized systems used in support of GMP processes, provide expert Data Integrity (DI) guidance, and support inspection readiness.

At our company, we aspire to be the premier research-intensive pharmaceutical company. We are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. We use the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. As a Senior Specialist Digital and Data Quality, you will play a vital role in ensuring compliance with our company’s policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities cover the quality aspects of data integrity, GMP computerized systems, master data management, laboratory instrumentation/systems, and supporting infrastructure used in site facilities, utilities, manufacturing, and laboratories to ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations.

  • Act as a change driver and strategic lead to site processes within the global Quality Management System (QMS) framework.
  • Influence the organizational future through review and approval of all quality-related activities, such as policies, procedures, plans, protocols, requirements, reports, deviations, and changes, as well as contributing to site inspection readiness.
  • Introduce strategic initiatives on site, driving standardisation across the GMP environment for computerized systems and data integrity, and representing DDQ in global governance meetings for data integrity, computerized system validation, master data management, and lab instrumentation / systems.
  • Promote cGMP and Data Integrity awareness and support a culture of continuous improvement. Help develop and maintain training on computerized systems validation, data integrity, and internal procedures.
  • Work together with the business to resolve regulatory non-conformances for cGMP computerized systems and data integrity in a way that ensures business efficiency and compliance. Drive improvements on both a local and global level, based on emerging trends, compliance gaps, and system weaknesses.
  • Act as a representative for DDQ management in site- and above-site meetings as needed.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • At least five years of demonstrable experience delivering validated IT solutions or working in an application support role.
  • Strong understanding of the current pharmaceutical industry and applicable regulations (FDA/EU/ICH)
  • Familiarity or practical experience in the implementation of quality systems in a pharmaceutical, laboratory, or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, complemented by strong communication and teamwork skills that add great value to the team’s success.
  • Timely decision-making and the ability to manage changing priorities, with strong project management skills, a sense of urgency, and a track record of delivering quality deliverables.
  • Extended experience with deviations, CAPA, change control, master data, qualification/validation, and inspection readiness in a GxP environment.

Ballydine is the primary Drug Substance commercialisation hub within the network, where new processes are scaled and transitioned to commercial manufacture. The site supports clinical and commercial API supply and the transfer of processes and technologies across internal manufacturing sites and external partners.

We keep the patient at the very heart of all that we do and strive to find solutions and treatments for some of the world’s most challenging healthcare needs. So, if you are ready to Invent solutions to meet unmet healthcare needs, Impact the future by driving one of the world’s leading healthcare companies, and inspire your team to reach their full potential and push the boundaries of science and technology, please apply today.

Additional location(s) Compensation Information

Required Skills

cGMP Regulations, Change Management, Deviation Management, Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP), Manufacturing Quality Control, Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance, Product Disposition, Quality Auditing, Quality Management Standards, Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, Strategic Planning

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

Advancing possibilities for a brighter tomorrow

Boston Scientific is seeking a highly motivated Graduate Knowledge Operations Analyst on a defined-term (23months) basis to join our Clonmel team.

Job Purpose

Start your career where your ideas, curiosity and technical skills can make a meaningful difference. As a Graduate Engineer at Boston Scientific, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, contribute to innovative medical technologies and build hands-on experience in a collaborative environment.

Create a knowledge library using a Power application by structuring, tagging and connecting information, including documentation, procedures, process maps and business change impacts, to a specific business hierarchy.

This is an opportunity to apply what you learned during your studies, develop your technical and problem-solving capabilities and gain valuable experience while contributing to technologies designed to improve patients' lives.

Key Responsibilities

Knowledge Management

  • Work with business partners to identify and locate knowledge items for the library.
  • Organize information, including features, process maps and training materials.
  • Establish relationships between connected knowledge items and the business hierarchy.
  • Maintain repository governance standards.

Metadata and Taxonomy Management

  • Apply classification and tagging standards.
  • Improve document discoverability through numbering, labeling or AI tools.
  • Ensure consistent naming conventions.
  • Support knowledge governance processes.

AI Enablement

  • Identify content quality issues.
  • Support AI search optimization.
  • Validate knowledge retrieval outputs.
  • Recommend repository improvements.

Education & Experience

  • Hons Bachelor Degree (Level 8) in engineering or science is essential.
  • Graduated within the past two years or currently in the final year of university.
  • Relevant work experience or completion of a co-op program, ideally within or knowledge of information systems/business administration.
  • Eligibility to work in Ireland.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the initiative to contribute in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong systems aptitude and an interest in developing technical skills.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive approach to learning and problem-solving.
  • Interest in medical technology, manufacturing, product development or continuous improvement.
  • Strong knowledge management, library science and data analytics skills.

What We Can Offer You

Competitive Benefits – we offer market leading benefits including performance-related bonus, pension contribution, onsite gym, onsite parking, subsidised canteen, organised social groups and healthcare.

A Career with Meaningful Purpose – opportunity to transform the lives of patients worldwide. 

Our Culture - our work is guided by core values that define our culture and empower our employees. 

Career Development – our highly engaged leaders will empower you to grow and will invest in your potential. You can also broaden your skills through personal development courses. 

Opportunity to Innovate – we encourage you to fulfil your true creative potential by speaking up with your ideas and solutions to problems that matter. 

Work-Life Balance – we have created a culture that acknowledges, respects and supports your life and work choices.  

Corporate Social Responsibility – we are dedicated to progressing business practices in areas important to our communities. Our onsite charity events have raised over €1.5 million for worthy causes in the past ten years. 

Boston Scientific Ireland Graduate Programme cosing date is 22nd November 2026.

As a leader in medical science for more than 40 years, we are committed to solving the challenges that matter most – united by a deep caring for human life. Our mission to advance science for life is about transforming lives through innovative medical solutions that improve patient lives, create value for our customers, and support our employees and the communities in which we operate. Now more than ever, we have a responsibility to apply those values to everything we do – as a global business and as a global corporate citizen.

So, choosing a career with Boston Scientific isn’t just business, it’s personal. And if you’re a natural problem-solver with the imagination, determination, and spirit to make a meaningful difference to people worldwide, we encourage you to apply and look forward to connecting with you!

To search and apply for open positions, visit: https://bostonscientific.eightfold.ai/careers

By embracing the richness of our unique backgrounds and perspectives, we create a better, more rewarding place for our employees to work and reflect the patients, customers, and communities we serve. Boston Scientific is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. job.description: Software Verification Engineer Location: Delft, Netherlands | Hybrid – 2 days per week on-site Salary: Up to €90,000 per annum (Visa sponsorship is offered for candidates who are already based in the Netherlands) We are looking for a Software Verification & Modelling Engineer to join an innovative deep-tech engineering team developing advanced technology at the intersection of software, signal processing and hardware. This role will focus on developing and validating software models, building automated verification frameworks, and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of complex algorithms and software implementations. You will work closely with software and hardware engineers to compare implementation outputs against trusted reference models, investigate numerical discrepancies, and improve the robustness of verification processes across the development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with strong C++ programming skills, a background in mathematical modelling or digital signal processing, and a passion for software quality, numerical accuracy and automated testing. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain and debug software verification frameworks using C++ and Python. Build and validate mathematical and behavioural reference models to verify software implementations. Perform golden-reference comparisons and numerical error analysis to identify discrepancies and ensure implementation accuracy. Design and maintain automated testing frameworks and continuous integration (CI) regression tests. Analyse algorithm behaviour, numerical precision and error propagation across complex processing chains. Investigate fixed-point arithmetic, quantisation effects and numerical accuracy where applicable. Develop reference models using Python libraries such as NumPy and SciPy, or MATLAB/Simulink. Implement testing strategies incorporating property-based testing, randomised test cases and automated regression analysis. Collaborate with software, FPGA and hardware engineers to validate models and investigate system-level issues. Contribute to the development of reliable, maintainable and scalable verification processes. Requirements Strong C++ programming and debugging skills. Professional experience in software testing, verification or test automation. A solid understanding of digital signal processing (DSP), mathematical modelling or numerical methods. Experience with reference models, numerical comparisons, algorithm validation or numerical error analysis. Proficiency in Python for verification, testing or automation. Experience developing or maintaining automated tests and CI regression pipelines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues. A relevant degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics or a related technical discipline. Desirable Experience Developing reference models using MATLAB/Simulink, NumPy or SciPy. Fixed-point arithmetic, quantisation analysis and numerical precision. Stateful DSP processing chains, including numerically controlled oscillators (NCOs), mixers and filters. Property-based testing and randomised verification techniques. FPGA or ASIC verification and digital hardware development. Hardware/software co-simulation, SystemC or cycle-accurate modelling. Validating software models against measurements from physical hardware.

job.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

At Jacobs, we're helping to deliver some of the most important water, flood resilience and environmental infrastructure programmes across Ireland and Northern Ireland.

With unprecedented investment being made across water, wastewater, flood risk management and climate resilience, we're growing our Water Catchment Management and Maritime team and are looking for talented Project Managers and Senior Project Managers to help shape a more resilient and sustainable future.

Build a Career That Matters

Jacobs has secured multiple long-term frameworks and programmes with key clients across the island of Ireland, including Uisce Éireann, Dublin City Council, the Office of Public Works, Northern Ireland Water and the Department for Infrastructure. Our work spans flood resilience, water infrastructure, catchment management and environmental improvement programmes that directly benefit communities and the environment.

Our project portfolio covers

  • Flood risk management and flood alleviation schemes
  • Water and wastewater infrastructure
  • Catchment management programmes
  • Natural Flood Management solutions
  • Surface water management and SuDS
  • River engineering projects
  • Coastal and maritime infrastructure
  • Climate resilience programmes
  • Feasibility, appraisal and optioneering studies
  • Detailed design, construction support and project delivery


About The Role

Whether you're an experienced Project Manager looking to take the next step or a Senior Project Manager seeking greater responsibility, you'll play a key role in delivering complex multidisciplinary projects across Ireland and Northern Ireland.

You'll work closely with technical specialists, clients and delivery teams to successfully manage projects from concept through to completion.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams through feasibility, design, procurement, construction and commissioning phases.
  • Manage project scope, programmes, budgets and project risks.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain project documentation, schedules, cost plans and progress reporting.
  • Support the successful delivery of major environmental and infrastructure programmes.
  • Ensure compliance with statutory requirements and project governance standards.
  • Drive innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement across project delivery.
  • Mentor and support junior project professionals while contributing to a collaborative team culture.


Here's what you'll need

We're keen to hear from professionals with project management experience across infrastructure, water or environmental sectors.

Your background could include

  • Water or wastewater infrastructure
  • Flood risk management
  • Flood alleviation schemes
  • Drainage and water resources
  • River engineering
  • Catchment management
  • Natural Flood Management
  • Surface water management and SuDS
  • Coastal or maritime engineering
  • Major civil infrastructure delivery
  • Design and construction management


You may also have experience with

  • NEC4 contracts
  • APM qualifications or chartership
  • Primavera or MS Project
  • Business case development (SOC, OBC, FBC)
  • BIM or digital project delivery tools


Most importantly, you'll bring strong leadership, stakeholder management and project delivery skills, along with a passion for solving complex environmental and infrastructure challenges.

Why Join Jacobs?

At Jacobs, you'll be part of a collaborative international team working on programmes that create lasting positive impact for communities across Ireland.

You'll have the opportunity to

✅ Deliver nationally significant infrastructure programmes

✅ Work alongside industry-leading specialists and multidisciplinary teams

✅ Build long-term client relationships

✅ Develop your career through exciting project opportunities

✅ Contribute to climate resilience and environmental improvement initiatives

✅ Grow within an inclusive and supportive culture where you can bring your whole self to work

Build. Lead. Innovate. Grow.

If you're a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager looking to work on some of Ireland's most important water, flood resilience and environmental programmes, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Jacobs and help shape the future of water infrastructure across Ireland and Northern Ireland.

Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees.

With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs.

We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.

Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles.

As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

  • Build every day — write code, create solutions, and ship
  • 3+ years of software engineering + 1 year of hands-on AI development

AI is moving quickly — but this role isn't about talking about what AI could do. It's about building it.


A leading global organisation is investing heavily in a major AI transformation programme, building new capabilities from the ground up. As an AI Engineer, you'll join a team where the expectation is simple: write code, build things, solve problems and make ideas work.

What You’ll Do Writing Linux user space and kernel code to allow 32-bit drivers to DMA 64-bit virtual memory spaces using both Intel and AMD IOMMU controller. Working on the hardware/software boundary for chips and the kernel. Where an x86 chip might have tens of registers, you will routinely work on ASICs with thousands of registers, tables, and special TCAM memories. You will program networking chips to provide latency analysis and keep accurate counts of events happening billions of times per second. You will write Python to bootstrap new hardware. You will build software agents that mediate and translate between the requirements of switching ASICs, high capacity custom FPGAs, media adapters, and PCIe bridges. You might tune lasers and measure and correct error rates measured in parts per billion. Implementing communications protocols between routers and switches at layer 2 (such as LLDP, 802.1x, BFD, etc), and layer 3 (such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS). Updating the forwarding state of the hardware, using platform-independent abstractions. Reconciling the linux kernel routing model with the switch's forwarding state. Implementing a policy language used for filtering and manipulating routing data received and advertised to peers Accessing ASIC registers over SPI bus, SMbus, PCIe and I2C, to implement high resolution timers (sub-100ns accuracy) and read ASIC hardware specifications to gather near-real-time information on large numbers of packet flows and to generate network congestion statistics. Developing configuration management services using Go and Python to support YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF and RESTCONF over gRPC, ssh and ssl for standardised switch configuration, combined with tools such as git, gerrit, Jenkins, Slack and Trello. Developing routing protocol agents (for BGP, OSPF, ISIS) in C/C++ within a Fedora Linux embedded environment. Coding of fault-tolerant, concurrent agents capable of handling the demands of future data centres where high performance and high availability are basic requirements. Fully automated, developer owned, Python based, continuous test harness with 100s of devices under test at any one moment. #LI-EO1 Any of the following:- C, C++, Java, Python, Go, react.js, redux.js, node.js Networking, Linux Embedded Systems, Algorithms, Programming, Software Development. job.description: Line of Service Internal Firm Services Industry/Sector Not Applicable Specialism IFS - Brand & Communications Management Level Senior Associate Job Description & Summary About PwC We believe that challenges are better solved together. That's why you'll join a diverse, global community of solvers - an unexpected mix of people that come together to build trust in society and solve important problems. With us, you are encouraged to lead with your heart and values, and where your unique skills are developed and put to work in unexpected and exciting ways, superpowered by technology. Firmwide Corporate Services Our Firmwide Corporate Services unite to help build our competitive advantage with first class support internally. Spanning Administration, Business Development, Chairman’s Office, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Learning and Development, Legal, Marketing and Communications, Operations and Change Management, and Technology, we power our lines of services to make sure all of us have the right sources, services and technology to be the best we can be. Not all of us work directly with external clients. Some of our most talented people choose to harness their skills, experience,  expertise and  service excellence within PwC. The possibilities are endless and our business landscape is changing everyday. PwC Singapore is seeking a Social Media Associate/Senior Associate to join the Brand and Communications team. Reporting to the Brand and Communications Team Lead, this role will help shape and execute the firm’s social media presence across key platforms, creating clear, engaging content that strengthens the brand and supports strategic priorities. The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller and content marketer who can turn complex business topics into compelling social-first content for professional audiences. You should be comfortable managing day-to-day content, supporting campaigns, working with stakeholders across teams, and spotting opportunities to raise PwC Singapore’s visibility through relevant, high-quality digital content. Roles and responsibilities Develop and manage PwC Singapore’s social media content across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and X, including using AI tools to support content ideation, repurposing and workflow efficiency. Own the social media content pipeline and editorial calendar, ensuring content is timely , coordinated and aligned to firm priorities, campaigns and platform best practices. Write clear, accurate and engaging social copy aligned to PwC’s brand voice and audience needs. Synthesise complex business and technical topics into concise, compelling social-first content. Partner with internal stakeholders to identify content opportunities and shape them into effective social formats. Develop digital assets for social media, including videos, visual cards, GIFs, infographics, carousels and other creative formats. Support the scripting and development of video and visual content for campaigns and always-on storytelling. Plan and optimise paid social campaigns to support amplification, targeting and campaign objectives . Drive follower growth across corporate social channels through content and channel strategies that expand reach and engagement. Monitor social trends, competitor activity, platform updates and audience behaviour , and recommend ideas to keep content relevant and effective. Collaborate with events, web, creative , campaign, media engagement, and employer branding teams , as well as with business stakeholders to promote initiatives effectively on social media. Manage content development and approvals across stakeholders, ensuring accuracy, consistency and strong attention to detail. Track and report on content and campaign performance, using insights to improve future content and channel strategy. Advise stakeholders on social media best practices, platform nuances and content approaches for B2B and professional audiences Qualifications and r equirements Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, journalism, business or a related field preferred. 2-3 years of r elevant experience in social media, digital content, brand, communications or marketing, ideally in a corporate, professional services or B2B environment. Strong copywriting and editing skills, with the ability to write sharp, audience-focused social content. Proven ability to simplify complex or technical topics into clear, engaging content for different audiences and objectives . Experience developing digital content assets, including videos, visual cards, GIFs, infographics and other social creative formats; familiarity with AI-enabled creative tools is an advantage. Experience or familiarity with video storyboarding scripting, shooting or editing. Experience managing paid social campaigns, including audience targeting, budget optimisation and performance tracking. Strong understanding of social media strategy, channel management, content planning and platform best practices. Experience using performance data and audience insights to optimise content and strengthen strategy; familiarity with analytics or social listening tools is an advantage. Experience working across cross-functional teams and with senior stakeholders. Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities. Strong attention to detail and sound judgment. A content marketing mindset and curiosity about what drives engagement and relevance. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Comfortable using AI responsibly to support content creation, research, optimisation and day-to-day workflow efficiency, with sound judgment and appropriate human oversight. Keen to learn, understand the business and stay current on PwC’s priorities and market developments. Why Join PwC Singapore You will be part of a team that brings PwC Singapore’s voice to life in the market.
